FIRE_SUMMARY.name: Fire observation summary
FIRE_SUMMARY.description: Summarizes fire observations and FRP within the selected area.

FIRE_LOCATION_MAP.name: Fire observation locations
FIRE_LOCATION_MAP.description: Displays observed fire locations on a map.

MONTHLY_FIRE_TREND.name: Monthly observation trend
MONTHLY_FIRE_TREND.description: Compares monthly changes in fire observations.

CONFIDENCE_ANALYSIS.name: Observation confidence
CONFIDENCE_ANALYSIS.description: Analyzes the confidence distribution of fire observations.

YEARLY_FIRE_TREND.name: Annual fire trend
YEARLY_FIRE_TREND.description: Displays annual trends harmonized across satellite sensors.

LARGE_FIRE_FREQUENCY.name: Large-fire frequency
LARGE_FIRE_FREQUENCY.description: Analyzes the frequency and return period of large-fire observations.

HIGH_RISK_SEASON.name: High-risk season
HIGH_RISK_SEASON.description: Shows the months with the highest share of fire risk.

NEAREST_FIRE.name: Nearest fire
NEAREST_FIRE.description: Finds the fire observation nearest the selected area's center.

FIRE_INTENSITY.name: Fire intensity classes
FIRE_INTENSITY.description: Classifies observed fire intensity by FRP.

DAY_NIGHT_COMPARISON.name: Day/night comparison
DAY_NIGHT_COMPARISON.description: Compares daytime and nighttime fire observations.

PERIOD_COMPARISON.name: Previous-period comparison
PERIOD_COMPARISON.description: Compares the selected period with the preceding period of equal length.

FIRE_HOTSPOTS.name: Fire hotspots
FIRE_HOTSPOTS.description: Displays grid cells where fire observations are concentrated.
